mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above the 3-year average, coinciding with a positive housing starts (HOUST) impulse, indicates a durable demand expansion that boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint signal triggers but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if the IC rank falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals weakening manufacturing and labor demand that depresses earnings expectations and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint signal triggers but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if the IC rank falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above the 12-month average, with no concurrent rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals robust labor demand that supports earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint signal triggers but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if the IC rank falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if the IC rank falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal income (RSAFS) below its 12-month average, accompanied by a concurrent drop in housing starts (HOUST), signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate earnings and yields negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint signal triggers but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if the IC rank falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below its 12-month average, combined with a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2.0%, signals easing inflationary pressure and accommodative policy that supports equity valuations and yields positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint signal triggers but 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if the IC rank falls below 0.05 over any 3-year window.
